data: verified canonical 2021-2023 1m/5m/15m/4h/1d plus mark and exact funding
economic_mechanism: An established scale-matched higher-timeframe order flow delivers price from confirmed internal liquidity toward still-unconsumed external liquidity. A completed 15m displacement is actionable only on the first causal 5m pullback/resumption that preserves the confirmed internal origin.

htf_state.causal_availability: pivot usable only after two completed right-side 4h bars
htf_state.bull: latest two confirmed 4h highs and lows are HH + HL
htf_state.bear: latest two confirmed 4h highs and lows are LH + LL

displacement.event: completed close breaks latest confirmed internal swing in HTF direction

entry.trigger: first later completed 5m bar trades into displacement-body midpoint and closes through it in the delivery direction while protected origin remains intact

risk_and_exit.target: nearest causally available still-unconsumed confirmed 4h or prior completed UTC-day external liquidity

decision_rule: A negative, sub-cost, sparse or winner-dependent deterministic 2022/unchanged-2023 result retires this exact implementation before ML, risk or official 2024-2026. No pivot, displacement, pullback, target, cost, risk, leverage, session or symbol-side rescue is permitted after outcome.
